ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the two models are near-tied on the relevant capability evals (Support Dialogue and Extraction both within variance), so capability wasn't the deciding factor. The tiebreaker was self-reported task preference. Explaining a set of exam objectives involves some open-ended elaboration, and Willet self-reports a measurable aversion to tasks with latitude, while Lapwing reports a flat (neutral) preference response. Since preference is dissociated from quality, this doesn't affect output quality — but routing toward the model without a reported aversion is the cleaner choice when capability is a wash.
